source: HD2Runtime research/wasp-rocket (ProjectileWeapon +40 spawns; a missile is unit-driven), research/explosion-identities (ExplosiveComponent +36 / +40 owners), filediver datalibrary/explosive_component.go (+36 ExplosionType, +40 ImpactExplosionType); records from the pinned generated_entities.dl_bin (one owner each)
about: Weapons whose shot spawns an entity (ProjectileWeapon +40) instead of firing a projectile row. unfired: the row (+0) is never used, the entity explodes by its own ExplosiveComponent (explosive: its record; payload: the explosion member offered as a reference, where the loader knows it; detonation: the explosion it sets off). carried: a missile carries the row as its hit row (damage, impact explosion) but flies by its SeekingMissile record (missile), so the row's flight fields do nothing.
